name: Threat Map
description: Live world map of the requests BunkerWeb blocks, with country drill-downs and one-click bans.

USE_THREAT_MAP.help: Enable the threat map page in the web UI (it reads the reports of the metrics plugin, so USE_METRICS must stay enabled).
USE_THREAT_MAP.label: Threat map

THREAT_MAP_MAX_EVENTS.help: Maximum number of recent blocked requests sent to the browser for the animation, the feed and replays (clamped to 1-2000). Statistics always cover every stored report.
THREAT_MAP_MAX_EVENTS.label: Threat map max events

THREAT_MAP_HOME_LAT.help: Latitude (-90 to 90) of your infrastructure, where the attack arcs land.
THREAT_MAP_HOME_LAT.label: Threat map home latitude

THREAT_MAP_HOME_LON.help: Longitude (-180 to 180) of your infrastructure, where the attack arcs land.
THREAT_MAP_HOME_LON.label: Threat map home longitude

THREAT_MAP_HOME_LABEL.help: Label displayed next to the home marker on the map (up to 32 characters).
THREAT_MAP_HOME_LABEL.label: Threat map home label
